profile: Clarus designs, develops, manufactures, and distributes outdoor equipment and lifestyle products through brands including Black Diamond, Rhino-Rack, MAXTRAX, TRED Outdoors, and RockyMounts. Its products include climbing, skiing, and mountain sports equipment; vehicle racks and accessories; off-road recovery gear; and bicycle racks. Products are sold through specialty and online retailers, company websites, distributors, and original equipment manufacturers.
